slots.label: Earth’s motion, day, night and seasons
slots.labelAf: Aarde se beweging, dag, nag en seisoene

items.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
items.qAf: Watter planeet is die naaste aan die Son?
items.explain: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, followed by Venus, then Earth.
items.explainAf: Merkurius is die planeet die naaste aan die Son, gevolg deur Venus, dan Aarde.

items.q: Which planets are the rocky inner planets?
items.qAf: Watter planete is die rotsagtige binneplanete?
items.explain: The four inner planets are small and rocky; the outer planets are much larger gas and ice giants.
items.explainAf: Die vier binneplanete is klein en rotsagtig; die buitenste planete is baie groter gas- en ysreuse.

items.q: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
items.qAf: Watter is die grootste planeet in die sonnestelsel?
items.explain: Jupiter is the largest planet, more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined.
items.explainAf: Jupiter is die grootste planeet, meer as twee keer so massief as al die ander planete saam.

items.q: What causes day and night on Earth?
items.qAf: Wat veroorsaak dag en nag op Aarde?
optionsAf: Aarde wat om die Son wentel
Aarde wat op sy as draai
Die Maan wat die Son blokkeer
Die Son wat om Aarde beweeg
items.explain: Earth rotates once about every 24 hours, so each side turns to face the Sun in turn.
items.explainAf: Aarde draai ongeveer elke 24 uur een keer om sy as, so elke kant draai op sy beurt na die Son.

items.q: What causes the seasons on Earth?
items.qAf: Wat veroorsaak die seisoene op Aarde?
options: The distance from the Sun changes a lot
Earth’s tilted axis changes which hemisphere receives more direct sunlight
The Sun turns on and off
optionsAf: Die afstand van die Son verander baie
Aarde se skewe as verander watter halfrond meer direkte sonlig ontvang
Die Son skakel aan en af
items.explain: Earth’s axis is tilted, so as it orbits the Sun, each hemisphere gets more direct sunlight in summer.
items.explainAf: Aarde se as is skeef, so soos dit om die Son wentel, kry elke halfrond in somer meer direkte sonlig.

items.q: Why does the Moon look different in different weeks?
items.qAf: Waarom lyk die Maan in verskillende weke anders?
options: We see different parts of its sunlit side as it orbits Earth
The Moon makes its own light
optionsAf: Ons sien verskillende dele van sy sonverligte kant soos hy Aarde wentel
Die Maan maak sy eie lig
items.explain: The Moon has phases because its sunlit side is seen from different angles as it orbits Earth.
items.explainAf: Die Maan het fases omdat sy sonverligte kant van verskillende hoeke af gesien word soos hy Aarde wentel.
